steps.name: Liaison from Lumen Union Headquarters
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Union Headquarters”.

steps.name: Ready to meet Iris
steps.objective: 1. After talking with [Yuran], go near the “Sanctuary of the Covenant.” 2. Meet [Iris] in the 「Oracle Room」 and talk to him.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Long time no see, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Yuran.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We are all grateful that Eastland has resolved the hard work and is moving forward.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: On behalf of everyone at Luman, I would like to thank you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? I have to do... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So I called you because I had something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Please speak.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris is no longer in Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He suddenly left a few days ago, saying that Gaia had called him. No, more accurately, he disappeared.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You definitely looked different than before. Before that, she was a human girl, but she seemed to be of a different class... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this what Gaia said about being able to meet Iris?)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I heard that Adventurer received an oracle a while ago. If you don't mind, may I ask about the contents of the trust?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia was looking for someone to meet her at the right time, and she blessed me by meeting me at that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And you said you would be able to meet Iris soon.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Perhaps it is an oracle decided by Gaia that Adventurer meet Iris.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: An oracle is originally a divine prediction of fate, but it differs depending on the interpretation.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So are you ready to meet Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course. I'm always ready to meet Iris.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I see. Then, I will tell you where Iris went. Iris said he would find out if he told Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He said he would be near the place that received Gaia's blessing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I know where it is.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then, I hope you can meet Iris and talk a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for helping Iris so far.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: No. Because I did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will meet Iris and come back. Eastland's work isn't over yet.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please proceed carefully.
(Yu-ran watches %s leaving the Luman Alliance Headquarters until he disappears.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Well, you should have come out and said hello to %s.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No, first sister-in-law.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: When that guy first came here, a lot of people didn't really trust him.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: However, he became an indispensable person by solving various dangerous problems and giving everyone confidence.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You ignored %s at first, but not anymore. You're probably feeling it too.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Becoming a superhuman is now... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No need to worry. You can't intentionally kill your allies rather than your enemies.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Okay, okay. I'm going to go check out the guild in the Forest of Water Lily now. Do you want to come with me?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No. I will step down... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Are you saying that an enemy could do this? No way, that’s not true….)
(A small road behind the sanctuary of the covenant. An unknown energy can be felt there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this... . It feels similar to when I met Gaia, but in a different way... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris is waiting. Let's hurry. You will find Iris.
(%s's vision shows the same place as when he met Gaia. It's definitely the same place, but the feel of the wind and sunlight, and even the atmosphere are different, so it's unfamiliar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the sanctuary of the covenant, but it feels different. It’s different from when Gaia was there… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there Iris over there? Iris… .
(When I call the name that has been lingering in my mouth, a girl appears inside.)
(A girl with a cute and lively appearance shows a flushed expression at the appearance of Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Welcome, %s… .
(Iris reaches out and grabs %s. Then, he approaches and gently hugs her.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know what to say or how to express it. Other than just saying thank you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I am… . I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just... .
(Iris steps back, wiping away tears.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I followed in Ceres' footsteps and became a star god, but I'm still human... . Having a heart... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So, as long as I can, as long as I have heart, I will do what I can for you. And I will be there for those who cared about me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I won't go far.
(As soon as Iris finishes speaking, a mysterious light begins to flow out and fill the space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s dazzling… .
(When my eyes are so dazzled that I can't open them properly, I hear Iris's voice.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now open your eyes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .
(The light surrounding Iris recedes and Iris appears in a different shape than before.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What should we talk about? Actually, this is your first time talking face to face, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: They say you met me in the Poison Mist Swamp, but I was out of my mind at the time. I should have said hello then... .
(Iris smiles playfully and then looks a little sad.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I wasn't trying to hide it, but it made me suspicious of you. That alone makes me a bad person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, what does that mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, at some point you almost became something you didn't want to be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is an unwanted being?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being who has no choice but to sin... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? uh? Wait, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Agashura… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The being who wants the destruction of this world placed a curse on %s before making me and you meet.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Whether he liked it or not, %s's spirit was eroded little by little every time he came into contact with the energy of destruction that the being wanted.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So you may have felt like you weren't yourself or acted like that.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I wanted to protect you. It's a weak power, but I wanted to use it for you. So, to avoid becoming like that %s, I erased the memories of those moments.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ah, so I remember… . And how I sometimes tried to act like something I wasn't... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That was the only thing I could do without awakening... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you have had too many days %s, you could become something you don't want to be.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: He must have become something that attacks everyone, including me, according to someone else's will. So, I asked Yuran not to let me meet him.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. If I were stronger, if I were a stronger being, %s you wouldn't have suffered like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Don't be sorry. It's okay because Iris protected me. It's because I'm weak... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry though. By not letting you remember Ceres... . I'll remember it clearly now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I remember Zenadia’s day clearly. I won't forget Iris either. I promise.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The traces of power given by superhumans belong to the ancient gods, and by receiving that power, I don't have to train anymore in the Forest of Training.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I now have the strength to protect my own Adventurer. So, I won’t create anything to misunderstand or hide. I promise.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I will rebuild the great wall for Gaia, who has worked so hard for me and for all life.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I am getting closer to the truth with the help of Gaia and the truth about the world that Ceres taught me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: In the meantime, I got information about Deimos through Adventurer, whom I was connected to mentally, but it wasn't enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. You can ask me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The thing about Deimos... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I already know. I will try until the end. So Iris will finish Iris's work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we need more superhuman strength, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now all that remains is the power of Io and Medea... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: First, meet Io. I think something is happening right now that Io doesn't know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and find out.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. You can meet me anytime you come here, so please come and visit me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… . Then I'll come back... .
(Iris smiles brightly, waves his hands and laughs. Then the light from Iris slowly approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This light, warm….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which direction should I go to get to where Io is? Was it the northern snowfield...? The closest place was Mars, so I'll have to go to Peonia and ask.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But, as Iris said, what would have happened if I had turned into an unwanted being, a sinner...?)
(Just like that, the light provided by Iris comes and goes, and Adventurer, who opened his eyes at the Eidos Gate of the sanctuary, slowly moves towards his destination.)

steps.name: How to get to the snowfield
steps.objective:
1. Take the portal in “Mars” and enter “Deborah Snowfield.” 
2. Defeat [Deborah Vingdal] and [Rampaging Vingdal] in “Deborah Snowfield” and report to [Titi] in “Deborah Snowfield.”

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Welcome, %s. long time no see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing much happened in Mars, right?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Nothing much is going on in Mars, but there's a bit of trouble in the nearby snow field. %s, do you know Deborah Seolwon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io is here… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: You know. It was a bit noisy as several demons and monsters that appeared from the well went that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Seeing as there has been no separate request from Gerda yet, the warriors there must have handled it well. I’m jealous… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: If you don't hire a troubleshooter, you'll see an anxious Mars... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I only told my story. So what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to Gerda to see Io, but I don't know exactly where I'm going, so I came to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mars is to the north, and Deborah Snowfield is also to the north, so it's close, right?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It's close, but you'll have to go back a long way. The road in the snowy area was rough, so I didn't travel well, and the road I was on disappeared.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Is it okay though?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: If you go straight inside, there is a small path. You'll just have to go back there a bit. Hey, didn't you see Beled on the way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to Mars thinking only about the snowy fields and couldn't go to the direction where Beled is. What's going on with Beled?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: After that incident, he would disappear for days, and it seems like that again this time. When I asked him, he said he just walked around and looked at people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It won't be a big deal. It shouldn't be... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even these days, Beled can’t come into town?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm trying to convince people, but I don't think Beled is ready yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Stop talking like this, you look busy, so go. If there are any monsters that seem to be in the way, I'll ask you to deal with them as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you for your concern, Peonia. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Yeah. bye.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: … When I see God's errand boy moving, I think something big will happen... .
(If you're not careful, it's a road where you could slip or fall into deep snow. The sight of such a snowy field extends endlessly as far as the eye can see.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's cold. The wind is sharp. Ugh, I almost fell... .

(I feel like I should be staring blankly at the blue waves swaying in the distance across the white snow field. In addition, pieces of ice floating in the sea are shaking according to the movement of the waves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought I would see something like this in Eastland... . Oh, but what is this? It looks like a sign, but should I read it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “This is Deborah Snowfield. If you feel like you might freeze to death because it is dangerous or cold on the way to Gerda Village, be sure to! “There’s a T-T in the middle, so shake the carrot.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Carrot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I shake the carrot, I suddenly think of Noel. First, let’s go to a place called a shelter.

steps.name: Going through a snowstorm...
steps.objective: Defeat [Ordinary Snowman] and [Unknown Wendigo] in “Deborah Snowfield” and report to [Galet] in “Gerda.”

lines.text: (There is a rare person standing in the center of the snowy field. A boy stands guard, pricking his fox-like ears.)
Hey, reveal yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s shake the carrot on the tree.)
Uh… , Did you come here after seeing the sign?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it said there was Titi so shake the carrot.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I am TT. Welcome. If you rest here, you will get better quickly. Where I am, there is an energy of purification, so my condition recovers quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The energy of purification?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: If you select the snow and ice in the Deborah Snowfield well, you can quickly make even contaminated snow and ice clean. But I feel like I’ve seen it a lot somewhere… , no! The appearance of a person who seems to have heard a lot.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Oh! uh! uh!

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Maybe you! Are you going to meet Sister Io?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it is, but… . Did you hear this from Io?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Sister Io said that! I heard from an older sister that an interesting-looking person would come someday. It's like this and that and that.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I told him to watch and guide me if I was here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A person who looks interesting in one way or another... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Io’s older sister? An interesting-looking person? If you heard it from Shinik, it must be me…)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I heard that he is a hero who appears like the wind in Eastland and takes on the Deimos Church with flying colors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not a hero, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give a brief introduction to Titi.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Are you okay now? Your body must have warmed up to some extent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it's true. I think the cold has gone away.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: It's been a long time since I've done this. How many hundreds of years has it been... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many hundreds of years?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: A long time ago, when the Deimos Church attacked our village, I escaped and ended up here. I'm from Cali. You know Media too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea too… .

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: After that incident, Mediah rebuilt a village somewhere, but I couldn't find it. So, when Sister Io visits me once in a while, she sends me her greetings.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Then shall we go? Please follow me. If you follow me, you won't feel much of the cold.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Titi, how do you know such things?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: I am not an ice spirit, but my spirit sister is in the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you a spirit? Is this the spirit I know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a town with many different beings… Well, Eastland is that kind of continent.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Sometimes, if you take a wrong step, you fall straight into the snow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaa!! Please tell me that in advance... … .

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Of all the people who came here, you fell in love the fastest. Please wait! I will somehow pull it out of the snow!

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Well, you should have listened to me carefully. Otherwise, I would have frozen to death!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I think it's okay because I defeated the monsters well and TT pulled me out of the snow.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Hehe, thank you. Ah, Galette is right there. Galette shines brightly today too! hi!

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: As expected, you are the only one who recognizes my face. But is the person next to you a traveler?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Yes, he said he came to see sister Io.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Is it him? Io was busy saying that a customer would be coming today.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Hello. My name is Gallet, and I run the inn Snow Flower, Flowers on Sparkling Snow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, nice to meet you. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Wow, I think I know the name. The hero who destroyed the Blue Spear Guild! I heard it from Madeline.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… , that's because of the circumstances. But it smells delicious.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I was making various dishes to serve to the villagers and guests.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will come here after seeing Io.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Of course you should come. %s, this is the only place you can stay. Delicious food, comfortable beds, it's the kind of place you'll want to stay once you visit.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: As expected, the galette is amazing.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Please have a meal while you are here.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Oh, really? %s, the cold is gone now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's less cold now that I'm in town. It's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: It's like Gerda's unique energy. Hehehe. As Galette said, go for a meal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that okay? I'm hungry right now. Then I will eat it gratefully.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: We've prepared 'Gallette's Special Deborah Risotto', which is simmered with special seasoning and goat meat broth, so enjoy!
(Spend some time at the inn while eating the delicious food prepared by Gallet.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Whoa, it was a good meal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had no idea Deborah’s goat meat was so delicious.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: The amount of goat meat that Uncle Baldrick ate was enormous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Baldrick… .

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: The wizard next to me ate almost as much as Baldrick... . Uh, it's going that way. Do you have anything to do with sister Io?

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: %s, then let’s go too. I will guide you to my sister.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Titi.

steps.name: shaking icicle prison
steps.objective: Defeat [Argos] in “Icicle Prison” and hear the story of the past. Then report the quest to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.text: (The mansion in the distance is covered in a thin layer of snow and ice. It feels like thin ice that will break if you even touch it with your finger.)
(In front of them, a neat-looking woman resembling beautiful snow crystals is talking to a wizard boy.)
Then let's go. Mr. Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Peta, thank you. It was helpful.
(The wizard boy called Peta speaks to Io and returns.)

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: Sister Io, we have brought you a guest.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, thank you. TT.

lines.speaker: 티티
lines.text: %s, I have some work to do so I'm going back to the snowy field. Talk to your sister. See you later too, Narin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take care, Titi.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Do it, Titi. If you say %s... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. Adventurer %s of Iris, the new god of the world… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Deborah I felt that the spirit's energy was quite different just in the snow, and it was Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. Because now Iris has changed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you feel it too, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I guess I'm a superhuman, so I can't help but feel those things... . Oh, that's right. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's good to be polite, but just call me Io. I'm comfortable with that.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please do so. Although Io seems cold and self-indulgent, he is actually a good kid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, yes. But this person… . government ordinance? Oh... . This is my first time seeing a spirit in a human village.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe, everyone is so surprised at first. I am the spirit of water and ice. Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io's parents saved me and raised me when I was lying in the snowy field. And I have been living here ever since.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: They cherished me as a child sent from heaven.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a good name.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Thank you. He also calls my name comfortably.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Enough greetings, I have something to say. If the goddess sent Adventurer here, she told her to help me, right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And the goddess will need my help too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Now, take this. This is Deborah's Ice. It's not regular ice. If I hold it until it melts, my power will be transferred to the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Io. But what can I help you with?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Deborah The snow and ice in the snowfield are melting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't feel the snow was melting when I came here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Probably not visible to %s. Because unlike what you see, there are some parts you can’t see… . If I say the other side, you understand, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After Goddess Gaia saved Eastland, Deborah became a snowfield. The land contains a special energy of purification, and life lives on the basis of that energy... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Those snowy fields are melting. When the snow and ice melts, it might seem like a warm, ancient Deborah, but that's not the case.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The reason this place has not been controlled by the power of restraint until now is because it was protected by the snow and ice of the Deborah Snowfield. Especially the Fountain of Echoes… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There is a very strong energy forming a snowy field there. My friend Spirit is there and he asked for help because Sam is melting due to some force.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But… .  It's been a while since I've seen you. It changed at some point. Don't let me in... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Something must happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But a spirit is a friend... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Just as humans are friends of spirits, spirits are friends of humans. Just like I do... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Echo is an ice spirit from the Well of Echoes in the Deborah Snowfields. This is someone I have never met. It is said that there are many spirits of water and ice there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there is a spirit, wouldn't you be able to go to Narin and meet him?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: But I don't know where it is, and even though I've found it, I couldn't go in. And I don't even know where I am now.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's just as I said. It was a place where only I was allowed... . Narin? Ah, Narin felt it too.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The icicle prison is shaking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The prison underneath the village... . Is there something in there?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go together, %s. I'll explain as I go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, please stay here as always. Please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Don't worry. The spirit of Narin will protect the village.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No matter how many times I hear that tone, I can't get used to it. %s, are you ready?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm ready. Then let's go.
(On one side of Gerda Village, as soon as you step through the bars firmly erected on the wall, you feel a strong chill that cannot be felt in a snowy field.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s must have felt it too. This is a prison where fanatics in bondage are kept. Deborah is purifying herself with the energy of the snowfield.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's already been several hundred years... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: At first, you may have innocently believed something, but didn't know it was wrong. My heart freezes and I don't recognize myself... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Being used by someone Kill another life, collect the power of life and give it to someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Some of those who only respond to Vice's messages are probably someone's family or friends.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I… , I wanted to save it. Father, mother... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There is nothing we can do about the dead, and we have little hope for those who survive and turn into monstrous beings.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Maybe it's my greed, but... . Shouldn't they see sunlight someday?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will happen someday.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, hehe.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So the new goddess is helping her gain strength. Because I can't do it on my own. Echo said he would help, but I didn't receive much... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, for now you have to watch from here. As the snowfield that contained the power of the spring melted, it seems that the icicle prison also melted. Is the spring heavily polluted?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It is a place made of ice that is harder than any other place... . I can't believe it's melting.

lines.speaker: 무언가의 울음소리
lines.text: KOOOOOOOO!!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This roar must be... . Wait, who's there?
Io-sama, Io-sama. Please save me... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Liriope? Why is Liriope here? Echo and be at the Well of Echoes. But what does that mean?

lines.speaker: 리리오페
lines.text: Please save me, save me. I'm sorry. I'm sorry that's all I can say right now. Although I released him, it was not my will. Please forgive me.
(Liriope turns into a water drop and disappears with a clear popping sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The way he speaks is similar to that spirit Narin... What on earth are you planning? And it seemed like he was waiting for me and Io to come.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Liriope? Save me? why?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If that's the case... . I can't believe I woke him up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Argos the Yeti, the sinner who created Gerda's hell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gerda's Hell... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Now that it's a monster that no one recognizes, we have to defeat it properly. I am stronger than then, and now I have %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew, let's go. Let's solve it quickly and get out!
(In the deepest part of the prison, a huge icicle erected to prevent a huge being from coming out has been broken.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Argos, come out.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Wow... . Hey… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Do you even remember me?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Hey… . Big... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I remember the hell you created for Gerda.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Biguuuuuuuuuuuck… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What hell is Gerda’s hell… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's a story I don't like, but I'll tell it to you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Deborah There were yetis living in one corner of the snowy plains, and my father was friends with him. Like me and Narin… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The Yetis were hunted by the Deimos Church, and when those who fought together returned, they were in bondage.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uncle Argus did not recognize the villagers he was fighting with and buried them in the ice, and my father stopped caring for my mother... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Those who survived managed to capture Uncle Argos and imprison him. Because that was it.  At that time, there was no one who could kill the powerful yeti... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When I was young, I gained strength and created a prison to prevent him from coming into the world.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I curse you uncle. But, I didn't want it to look like this. This is all what Vice wanted!!

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, can you do it?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. I can do it. You have to do it. If you don't do it, you will never... . uh?
(The wall in front of Io splits and the hanging icicles fall.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The speed at which ice melts has accelerated... ? Narin, is Narin not in good condition?
(Io gathers the chill surrounding him and spreads a barrier around the prison.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When the prison collapses, Gerda becomes dangerous... . However, I have to deal with Uncle Argos... .
(Argos raises a huge ice blunt and attacks Io. However, he is surprised by %s's counterattack and falls back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That yeti doesn't seem to recognize me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: (I can't believe I accurately countered Mr. Argos' attack...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will fight. So, Io, please don’t let the icicle prison collapse!!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay!! So be careful!! Because Uncle Argos is very angry right now.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Wow!! Wow!! Wow!!
(As Argos screams in a loud voice, Io's barrier shakes. Even the cracks on the walls of the icicle prison grow bigger and bigger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you have no choice but to try it... .
(As soon as %s's strike lands, Argos collapses, losing strength.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have to take it down properly. otherwise… .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Crrrrr… . eww… . eww… . Why am I… .Who are you? Weaver? Where are we… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weaver? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Working with the goddess... , isn't it? Why am I here? I definitely... . Why am I attacking you?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Inachus and I... . I am… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Argos?!

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: This… oh? Is this right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Are the bonds broken?
(Io is approaching Argos with an expression of disbelief, but falls in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: That's right Io. When I see you fall unexpectedly... . Now, wake up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it's dangerous.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It’s okay, %s… . Step back.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You are a man. The man hasn't changed... . It hasn't changed, but the restraints... .
(Io stands up holding Argos’ hand. Various emotions that have been suppressed for a long time are shaking inside Io.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because he doesn't remember anything... . sorry… .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: So tell me the story of the time I was in bondage. I will accept everything... .
(Argos looks at Io with resigned eyes.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Gerda's hell that you created... .
(Io wipes her tears and looks up at Argus. Then she sits in front of him and talks about the past time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's such a terrible story... Why do superhumans go through these ordeals...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I was in bondage and did not recognize my friends and committed a sin. sorry.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: By the way, when did you and dad meet Vice? The only thing that can bind you like this is a vise... .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: While we were chasing fanatics of the Deimos Church who appeared in the snowy fields, we found a spring and a spirit lying in front of it with no memory.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: The young spirit couldn't remember why he was here, and he was afraid. So Inachus returned to the village with the spirit.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Later, we discovered that some of the binding force was created and spread from the spring. While investigating the place, a spirit became frightened and asked for help.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: We wanted to know about the request of the spirit whose wings were frozen. Why do I feel both the energy of purification and the power of restraint in the spring... .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Inachos, who could communicate with the spirit, promised to restore the spirit's wings.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: But one day, a spirit led them inside the spring. That was a miscalculation. The spirit's eyes had changed into a different atmosphere than the eyes I had seen before.

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: We were frozen by the spirit's attack and then we met Weiss. and… .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: I tried to do something, but it wasn't a normal spirit attack. The spirit already possessed an alien power.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Uncle Argos, what does that spirit look like?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: It was tall and had only half of its frozen wing. Echo is clearly the guardian of the Fountain of Echoes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He was clearly Io's friend...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo? Echo?

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: My memories end there... . I'm sorry. Hey… . I will pay for my sins. Come on, kill me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … is it so. If that's what you want... . And as Gerda’s representative, it’s something I can do… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It was something I had decided to do anyway... .
(Before Io finishes speaking, a huge and ominous force comes flying from somewhere. However, Io notices it and creates a huge ice shield to bounce it away.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Looks like there's someone who wants to freeze to death. Have you come this far with the power of restraint? How dare you… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This must be… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, the attack just now... ?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, come out. Come out and talk.
(With Io’s words, ice bounces from the ground like water droplets, forming the shape of a woman.)
(The frozen spirit's wings feel beautiful, but when you look at the broken left wing, you feel an ominous power.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Echo? That spirit... .
(The moment Argos tried to approach Echo, dozens of huge, sharp icicles sprouted from Argos' entire body.)

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 아르고스
lines.text: (Argos' face falls to the floor helplessly.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Argos?! echo?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, what are you doing!!

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: help me... .
(Echo smiles lightly and looks at Io.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Hey, save me... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … echo?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Please listen to me... . I, I… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You clearly told me I couldn't leave the Echo Well, right? But what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Plus, it's spreading the power of bondage, which I hate. And ask me to save you? What on earth… . I can't go in now.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Hey, save me... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: save me So come to the Fountain of Echoes... … . Because the road to the spring is open for you... .
(Contrary to what Echo says, he creates huge ice as if he will attack Io at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The spirit called Echo is in a strange state. If things continue like this, Io is also in danger... Huh?)
(The sharp icicles created by Echo melt and fall to the floor. And the spirit Echo also turns into water droplets and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: save me me… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Haha… . ha… . Oh, I'm suffocating. I can't breathe. Ugh, ugh… . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Come on, we have to get out quickly. There is a lot of bondage here... . Echo spread it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, come to your senses! Because I will hold on to you!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Narin! Let’s go to Narin!)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s! I've been waiting for you! Please come here quickly.
(As soon as Narin sees the group, he creates huge water droplets and sends them towards the entrance of the Icicle Prison.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If this continues, no evil power will come out of the icicle prison.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, I want to know what happened... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, talk to Narin… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. I just wanted to clear things up in my head for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll talk to Narin. Narin, what happened in Icicle Prison... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Narin what happened in the Icicle Prison.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Are you saying that the spirits of Echo and Liriope did this because they asked you to save them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Narin… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Moreover, he even attacks with the power of restraint... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I can't know anything here now. So I guess I'll have to go there and find out... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin… . You stay here.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: No. If it's a spirit's job, I'll be more helpful than you, a human. It's safe here. Oh, do you doubt my strength?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's not like that. I'm just talking about the fact that you can't get close to the Fountain of Echoes.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: … Maybe I'll find out what I want to know.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When was the last time you tried to go in?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Maybe 50 years ago... . If you were trying to enter the area where the spring is, you must have been blocked by the barrier that had spread out. That was the place you took me to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Clearly Narin and the spirit called Liriope looked similar...)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, I'm going too. Can I accompany you? %s, may I come along?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but Io... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go to the Fountain of Echoes. I will take the lead. Let's go and meet Echo.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … If what Uncle Argos says is true, then Echo must be hiding something. I need to know that.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Because I have a duty to know for the sake of the snowfield and the village.
(As Io speaks, cold air flows out from her fingertips. She struggles to hold on to her energy so as not to be shaken.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Icicles born from the power of restraint sprouted from all over my body. Yetis and people died because of those icicles.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No country can handle such an attack. At least it would be okay if it was Shinick’s sister… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That scary sister... .
(Narin’s expression turns pale momentarily.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Nothing comes. Ahahaha… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hahahahaha… .
(Narin seems to momentarily panic.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It seems like a long time has passed, but Shinick unnie's name alone is like that. Come to your senses, Narin!
(Io grabs Narin and shakes her violently.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Aaaah, I'm dizzy. Oh oh oh... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As the situation is urgent, let's go quickly. There is no need to pray for Uncle Argos’ peace.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, will you come with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course we should go together.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. I knew that would happen. Then let’s go to where Madeline is.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Madeline is the warrior of our village. A very good archer.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, let's go. To where Madeline is… . To meet Echo... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if it's not okay, I have to be okay. I don't know what Echo is hiding, but if it's to shake Gerda... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It must be destroyed in the name of the goddess... . Phew, I'm not sure if the goddess wants it or not... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Now, shall we go?

steps.name: The past trapped in ice
steps.objective:
1. Defeat “Echo” in “Fountain of Echoes” and obtain <Ice Wings of Binding>. 
2. Return to [Madeline], check some memories, and report the quest to [Madeline].

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Io, Narin? What happened... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Nothing special happened here, right?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Madeline, did anything happen?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Something a little strange has happened. I'm still not sure if Sam is here, but I've been keeping an eye on him like you said.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: The flow and energy of the water have definitely changed... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As expected, Madeline is an outstanding talent. Galette here gave me a packed lunch for Madeleine, so eat it when you have time.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Thank you, Io.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Galette packed Madeleine a lot of what she likes.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: But who is this person?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you. %s… no see.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Maybe Madeline might know someone.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: You are the one who defeated Landain... . Thank you. If you hadn't done that, that person would have become even more of a monster.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Don't worry too much. %s was just doing his job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Madeline’s face looks complicated….)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Io, are you planning to go to a place called Sam?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. But, it will be different from before. Madeline, I have a favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Please speak.
(Io gives Madeline a small piece of ice.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If this ice melts, go to town right now and set my mansion on fire. And then go straight to Mars with the villagers.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If you do that, Uncle Baldrick will come.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Io-sama, that means… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I am here, and Narin is here. Moreover, there is also %s, a man of the goddess.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: At least it doesn't hurt the people I love. You know Madeleine, right? What kind of person am I?
(Io grins and taps Madeline on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can definitely feel that he is a person with a strong heart…)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, %s, let's go.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, it seems like a barrier is blocking me. It seemed like he just blocked me before, but now he's rejecting me. Just me... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, wait a minute… .
(Io stretches out her hand and stirs it, and makes an unpleasant expression as if she felt something.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It’s changed… . I can't go to Narinman... . Hey there, %s. Reach out here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but what do we have here? Uh, here… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if you don’t want to feel it, you feel it, right? This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I'm sure.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narine, then stay here with Madeline. If you are here, the snowfield and Gerda will not be shaken... . And if anything happens, with Madeline… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Okay, I got it. Without further ado, go on your way.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Narin. %s, let's go. follow me

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Welcome, Io, %s.
(A small water channel visible through the ice flows somewhere. The water visible through the field of view is colored in an unknown color, possibly due to contamination.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Come to your senses. This energy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will be careful. Hey, there are water drops in front of me... .
(As soon as you enter the Fountain of Echoes, the same water droplets you saw in the Icicle Prison rise from below.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's that spirit.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, it's a spirit called Liriope. Serving alongside Echo... . However, it is a being that should not be looked upon carelessly.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Liriope is a high-level spirit. Even if it's not like Harmonia and Geass, who stay in the goddess's world of images... .
(The water droplets slowly gather together and turn into the shape of Liriope.)

lines.speaker: 리리오페
lines.text: Io, please forgive me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What on earth are you asking me to forgive? Are you still trying to say it's not your will?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That spirit is acting differently from its mouth. It looks like it's going to kill us at any moment... There's no way Io wouldn't know.)

lines.speaker: 리리오페
lines.text: It is not my will. This is all… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I guess so. Being able to abuse a high-level spirit like Liriope must be a powerful thing. However, God does not treat spirits like this carelessly.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, come out. What on earth are you planning?
(Ice bounces from the ground like water droplets, surrounds Liriope as she tries to escape, and freezes her. Then, one of the droplets slowly changes into the shape of Echo.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Hey, you came to save me.
(After a while, Liriope's frozen body cracks little by little and falls apart.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo? What on earth have you done... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: As expected, Io, you came to save me. This is not my will. It's okay though. It's okay because there's another Liriope for me.
(Echo flaps his wings vigorously with a bright smile. However, his small wings do not move properly and he is in pain.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Ugh… . This is all… . Save me. Save me... . Come to the end of the spring... .
(Echo's appearance as he was complaining of pain freezes. After a while, Echo disperses like water droplets and flows somewhere into the Fountain of Echoes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, you need to think carefully. Liriope was afraid, but not Echo. I was enjoying it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I know. I was acting like I was in bondage like Uncle Argos... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: At this point, I can't be fooled anymore. I'll have to listen to Echo's story more... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go, %s. The Fountain of Echoes has many paths that keep repeating, so follow them carefully. Besides the spirits, I am the only one who knows the way here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Then let's hurry up. I don't know what that spirit will do... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If you follow the flow of clear water... .
(A place where the flow of clear water stops, and the unpleasant feeling is stronger as purple-colored ice and water mix together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even Echo can't deny it anymore. There are two people here who have been affected by this power.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Then, should we try making Echo come out?
(As soon as the words are finished, a huge ice crystal blooms at the tip of Io's finger.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, you won't be able to bear it.
(When Io waves her hand, huge ice crystals break into pieces and fall all over the spring. After a while, the ice crystals melt and the divine power spreads out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It feels similar to when I met a goddess.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It was a mixture of many things. Especially when purifying… .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The spirit’s scream….)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo, come out and talk.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Ugh… , big… .
(Ice crystals come together to create the shape of Echo. Echo, who appears to everyone, is standing with difficulty, covering her body as if in pain.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I'm glad you came to save me, Io. But, we must not purify this place... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Why doesn't it work?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Then I can't go out. Because this power is the means that allows me to go outside.
(As Echo grins, the energy of purification disappears without a trace. And the ominous power becomes stronger, creating a huge icicle.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … What on earth are you doing?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Thank you for letting that child come here... . I will destroy that child with the power I have gathered so far.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: They trapped me here and never let me out... .
(A huge icicle slowly rises into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You can't believe it... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, what does that mean? That spirit says... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So you're trying to kill Narin?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: … When that child dies, all of Deborah's snow and ice will melt. Hey, don’t you want that too? Deborah's life free from snow and ice?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You are crazy because of the power of your bindings.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I'm not crazy. I was just mistaken that you were my friend... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: When the time comes, those icicles will fall exactly. Io, thank you. For believing in me and coming to this place that will become your grave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … You're using faith as bait. It's a waste of a name for me.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: It doesn't matter. I have to go out. I must take revenge on those who imprisoned me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Io, Io, quickly go to the entrance of the spring.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s? What is that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I will defeat that foolish spirit somehow. Defeating this spirit might be... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It might be for Iris. So Io, hurry and get out!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, so hurry!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay. Please!!
(Echo watches quietly as Io runs. Then, he quietly turns his face and feels %s's gaze.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: … This world will no longer exist. I'm going to get out of here before he gets his way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's a Vice story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you don't deny it, I guess it's true. Then I will deal with you properly. At least I should let you know that your choice was wrong.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Like humans... .
(As Echo opens her closed eyes, the binding force hovering around Sam becomes stronger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s dangerous if it takes too long. I need to finish it quickly.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Wow!!
(The spirit's pained screams echo throughout the spring. The repetition of the sound, like Sam's name, is enough to make even the listener feel like he is in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Give up now, Echo.
(Echo sits down and covers his body with a painful expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's nothing you can do now. You know that using the power of binding was wrong, right?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I just wanted to get out. I just told the gods not to leave this world, so why was I punished? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it an ancient spirit? It's definitely not an ordinary spirit...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you were trying to get out with the power of restraint?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Is that wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not with the power of the spirit, but with the power of binding? Don't you know what the power of bondage has been doing to Eastland?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: As long as I get out, I don't mind the power of restraint. Because the strength that Weiss gave me allowed me to go all the way to Gerda.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: If the spirit's power and restraint come together, it is possible to take revenge on the being who trapped me here... . So I woke up Argos, who was in bondage, and waited for Io and the child to come here as well!!

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: You ruined everything!! Cluck, cluck… .
(As Echo screams, the ice wings behind her fall.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: You ruined everything... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What Argos said wasn't a lie... . I deceived Io and pretended to be her friend for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Me, I… .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: He said I could get out of here if I could use the power of binding, so I did just that... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I didn't know I would lose something precious to Io... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: It was Io who cared for me so much... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Ugh, uhhh… .
(Echo begins to tremble in pain. The miasma of restraint surrounding Sam then gathers and disperses repeatedly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's strange. Something's strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is there?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Vice, kill me!! Better kill me!!
(Along with Echo's cry, a huge spray of water rises from the waterway. And the body of %s who was watching it is blown away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Echo?! What on earth are you doing... .
(With a thud, the huge icicle floating in the air falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Icicles suddenly... . echo?
(The place where Echo was is littered with broken ice pieces, and the being that was Echo has disappeared without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it was called Vice... . vise?
(A person with ominous power slowly walks out from between the pieces of ice with rising water mist.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It’s been a while, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Foolish spirit... , Even though he is suffering from the power of restraint, he makes this choice for Io... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth have you done?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It's just that the power of binding was shared a long time ago. When the spirit used it, it polluted the spring and cast it on the yetis and people.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Those who took on different personalities simply fought and killed each other and offered their life force to me. Is this enough of an answer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What on earth do you want? Azrael, what on earth is doing this?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A world loved by life from another world... . I'm starting to forget little by little too. Because of that contract... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Relax the hand holding the weapon. If you die here, the goddess will be sad, but will that be okay?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: See you soon in Avalon... . I'll be waiting.
(As Weiss smiles, a purple flame appears from nowhere and burns. The flame surrounds Weiss, and after a moment, it disappears without a trace before our eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, all the ominous energy I felt inside the spring has disappeared. Because Echo disappeared? Or maybe the vise is gone... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Deimos appears in Avalon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go out and meet Io. It's not too late to decide after that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what is that? ah… . Echo's wings... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to take it out and show it to Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The icicles in the sky have disappeared.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: A lot of the ominous energy has disappeared. By the way, Io and Narin? Now I want to come out from between the two of you... .
(Madeline, who was sandwiched between Io and Narin, who were holding hands and creating a barrier, raises her hand.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Uh, okay.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: In the meantime, Vice came and went.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Coming this far and not doing anything... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That mean person, as usual, planned something and exploded it. As always. It's somewhat predictable, but let's listen to %s who is still coming.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, the ground is freezing again.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Should I say freezing is normal... . From our perspective, it’s normal, but… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Ugh… .
(Narin looks up at the sky and suddenly collapses.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'm not sure. Why am I doing this? Unlike usual, I have no energy... .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: For now, it seems okay... . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Narin! I'm here. uh? Narin, what's going on? The icicles must have disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What are you holding in your hand right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Io what happened with Echo and show him the item that used to be Echo's wings.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Echo's ice wings are filled with the energy of restraint... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Maybe this... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, why?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, can I use this?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The feeling of restraint still remains. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Nothing will happen. So let me write it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yeah. Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You can wake us up in about an hour. If you can't sleep, you can use Deborah's eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does it mean to fall asleep?)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, I will.
(Narin unfolds the scroll in her arms and places Echo's ice wings on top. After a while, the ice wings slowly melt and become small water droplets, rising into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, this is… .
(Io and Narin lean against the ice rock side by side as if nothing is wrong and close their eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly I fall asleep... I shouldn't be like this...)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Don't worry, just close your eyes. It won't hurt. Because Narin and Io said it was okay... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(Madeline gathers her eyes in front of %s, who is trying to come to her senses. Moments later, a huge snowball flies into %s's field of vision at a speed so fast that it makes a cracking sound.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Looks like you arrived safely.
(Io looks at the face of the fallen %s and wipes away the snow powder from his face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what happened? I think I got hit by something... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's my mood, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit awkward to do that.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, you’ve experienced this a lot, right? It will be similar this time too. It's about examining someone's memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? ah… . yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Io knows it too.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'm sorry, Io. I didn't know. I wonder if the memory Echo's wings had was from that time... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's okay. Because it can't be helped. Ah, %s. Now just watch quietly. Just look. You will know everything when you watch... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After watching it all, I'll curse Weiss again... .
(When Io and Narin make eye contact and look forward again, their appearances disappear without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(It's just Deborah's landscape full of white snow and ice. Then, a familiar voice is heard from the snowy field.)
This is... . This is not it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's Echo's voice.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: … This is not me... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I simply wanted to get out. This is not what I wanted.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: I, I… .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Weiss, you ruined me... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It's not you that I ruined. It's a different life... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You knew from the moment you accepted the power of the other world.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: No, no. I am… , I am… .
(As Echo gets scared, huge ice crystals float around her. They fly away as if trying to stab Vise, but they soon melt and disappear in front of Vise.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The curious spirit looked into the gap in space and time and was assimilated into the energy of another world.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: He hated other spirits who were concerned about this, so he stabbed their eyes with icicles and prevented them from seeing them.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: When the Spirit King of Water and Ice found out about this, he became angry and banished the spirit, but he still cared for it and allowed it to stay in a certain place.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Such a spirit king once came here. When the Spirit King came, the spirit approached and bound him, pretending to regret his mistake... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Stop… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The Spirit King managed to get out of the spring, but soon disappeared. The spirit used the humans and yetis who came to find the missing spirit king and take revenge.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Stop, stop!! no… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: No. This is an undeniable fact.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I've seen many humans wearing masks, but this is my first time seeing spirits. Did you try to become Nemesis, the goddess of revenge?

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Don't come closer... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The power of bondage is the ugliest thing that life in this world possesses... , if it is connected to me now… .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Disappear!!
(A huge piece of ice rises from the floor and tries to penetrate Weiss' heart at high speed, but it shatters right before his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: … I am not the type of person who will disappear just because a spirit tells me to disappear.

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Ugh, uh… . I can't move.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Beautiful spirit wings... .

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: W-what are you trying to do?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Since I can no longer fly, I don't need these wings... .
(Vice approaches Echo, grabs her wings, and breaks them. One of Echo's wings remains frozen and shatters.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaa!!
(The spirit's screams, which are so painful that I don't want to hear them, continue to echo through the spring.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: How does it feel to be bound by the bondage you want? So gather your life force in bondage whenever I want!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Just like when Gerda used the humans and yetis who were trying to help you to kill each other!!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: And when the time comes, open your eyes again, and when the time comes, close them again. Like a weak goddess... .
(Echo, who was complaining of pain, stops moving. He closes his eyes and turns his head toward the vice.)

lines.speaker: 에코
lines.text: Yes… .
(%s's field of vision is filled with a snowstorm blowing from somewhere. And the images of Vice and Echo that he had been seeing are slowly erased.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Such ridiculous cases... Why do people who are called superhumans experience these things?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, you're awake. Madeline, put down the snowball you’re holding.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes. Mr. Io.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Getting hit by a snowball hurts more than you think. So don't use it often.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: It's a shame.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Io... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's over now, that's enough. The frustration was relieved a bit. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll say it again, even though I feel sorry for my father and Uncle Argos, I won't pray for their souls to rest in peace. Even if it happened... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's not worth talking about things like Echo, since that was their fate anyway, and they just paid the price for their sins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I just learned something I didn't know. This gives me even more reason to kill Weiss?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew… .
(Io lets out a short sigh with a lot of meaning. Then, he smiles lightly and looks at Narin.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, I’m sorry. I thought all water and ice spirits looked like older sisters like Echo.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe, this guy is talking so sweetly that he's freezing to death.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can freeze to death too. Even if he looks like this, he’s a superhuman!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, I found out what happened before you came to the village. What do you think? Spirit King… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens to Narin then?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If nothing happens, we'll just continue living in our village. Narin, will you do that?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, I have no place to go, so I will stay in Gerda like Io said.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: God has let me stay in Gerda, so I guess I will stay that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that would be correct.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: And thanks to Echo, I found a use for this scroll, so I will use it to help in the future.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thanks to Echo... . Thanks to you. You are the Spirit King. Isn't it? Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Be polite, Blizzard Empress. Now that I think about it, they are all the same king. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: … Are you having fun there?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As Madeleine said, my jokes are a bit boring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, it gave me confidence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was I perhaps unreliable?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, it's not like that. Then shall we go to the village and talk?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What do you want Madeline to do?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I'll take a look around the snowy field and take turns. I'm a little hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madeline, what about the lunch box Gallet gave you earlier?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I ate all three while waiting. Several hours have already passed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Time... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It took quite a while this time. I thought it would be a brief moment. First, let's go back. We'd better go back and talk.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Please return carefully.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, Io.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, then go back to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madeline, see you later.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, bye… .

steps.name: with delicious food
steps.objective: After talking with [Io] in “Gerda,” go to [Galet].

lines.text: (Io looks around while Narin goes to ask Gallet to prepare food.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After all, I can't give up on this place. If Narin was like Echo, she would definitely have done the same. There's no way Narin would do that, but just in case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm just talking to myself, so don't worry about it. Ah, %s, there was something you didn't see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There was something that Echo's wings showed only to me and Narin.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I guess he wanted me to destroy him. But, Vice wouldn't allow it. Echo said that we must use all of our binding power... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Surely that will happen in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Look at the sky over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't see anything. Just clouds... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Wait, %s. Narin, please do me a favor.
(Narin, who has returned, nods as soon as she hears Io's words. After a while, a sparkling ice crystal appears from nowhere and rises into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The ice crystals will have an ominous energy. Look where this is going now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think the crystals are flying south. If it's south... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yep, Avalon with a vise. Even the faint energy of restraint that remained on the continent is rushing to one place like that.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Do you know what that means?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Deimos… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A task big enough to require all one's strength. It must be an attempt to summon Deimos.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: In fact, this time too, he would have used Echo to melt the snow fields, and if life was polluted, he would have used the power of binding to take it away.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Once again, I'm sorry for leaving my job to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, thanks to the disappearance of Echo, who was carrying the power of restraint, Sam's purifying energy became stronger.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We have come a little closer to the truth of bondage, but it is not enough. So I'm going to incorporate this further.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As if Uncle Argos' spirit had returned for a moment, I felt like simply loosening the restraints wouldn't work... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Don't doubt Io. Even though he looks sloppy, he is accurate and persistent.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, then I will tell the goddess and change my position.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Huh, that's bad.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew, that's it. Listen carefully, %s.
(The moment Io is about to tell %s something important, Gallet's voice is heard from afar.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Io, Narin, and %s, the meals have been prepared. You can come and eat!!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I’ll be there soon, Galette!!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, %s!! Don't think about anything for now, just eat and rest to clear your complicated mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I was hungry right now.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Then go.
(Io and Narin take %s by the hand and lead him to Gallet's Inn, which smells of delicious food.)

steps.name: gypsum flower sea
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] in front of [Gallet] in 「Gerda」 and then go to [Peta].

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As expected, Seolhwa’s food is the best. I asked you to make a new food especially for God's Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a good time. It was so delicious. But I have a question. Narin is a spirit, so I wondered how she could eat human food so well.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io's parents took me in, and from the moment I decided to return the favor to them, I was able to eat like a human.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Mir sometimes brings me strange food, and the two of us eat it well. I heard that a spirit elder from a certain continent prepared food exclusively for spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's out of the way, now let's talk about what's left.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: 'We', connected to the power of God, will head to Avalon when that day comes. To do that, we must first tear down the barrier that blocks that place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is bondage? ?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A kind of technology that allows the power of life to be created elsewhere... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: After a long period of research, I recently learned something. When I found something new by disassembling and combining the magic stones created by the Deimos Church and the fake Agashura... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The energy of destruction flowed out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? The energy of destruction?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It felt like the gods were disappearing, like in ancient times when a primal being appeared to destroy this world. When parts of my body were about to split and disappear, Gaia protected me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: He tells us that this is the power possessed by the primordial being that wants to destroy this world... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I was going to say thank you to Gaia, but I couldn't feel it. I've never had anything like this before... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even when I was asleep, I felt like I was in this world... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, although my research has been put on hold for a bit, I will do it again. You may feel the energy of destruction again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As you can see, I'm fine. And it should be okay. I will never break down for the sake of not just us, but the goddess and everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, and I won't leave it all to you. Because I have prepared something in the meantime. The unshackled heart of the man will also be a good example... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But if you say everyone, it’s still… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about that. Miss Medea is probably ready now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's because Miss Medea likes Io. Hehe, you probably like me more than Shinick unnie?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I think it's natural to like Io more than that scary older sister.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let’s pretend you didn’t hear what I said, rest here for a few days, and then go see Miss Medea. Since you are going in the name of Io, I will welcome you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There won't be any witches in Eastland to disturb us for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You know, right? Daphne... . The witches are quiet so I'm looking into them.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … When and if the combination of vise is correct. Now I'm watching again.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hmm… … .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This isn't important right now, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, now let’s start with the vise first… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Witch….)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, what are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm asking about your plans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll go back to Iris and tell him what happened here. And I will wait for Io to contact me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, okay. I will call you when the time comes, so come to Gerda. uh… .
(Io is puzzled when he sees Peta approaching him.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Peta, what's going on? If it's about magic, come next time.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: No. I waited for Io and Adventurer to finish speaking. I have something to say to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a huge magic book... I don't think he's an ordinary wizard...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I'll have to hope it's not a big deal. Normally, in these situations, what you would say to someone like %s is... . Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and find out what's going on. Okay, then I'll say hello here.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yeah. okay. See you later then. Narin, say hello to %s and let’s go. Peta, talk to me later.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, please stay healthy and come visit us again later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Narin. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Now, Adventurer, would you please come over to where I am?
(Peta puts down the huge wizard he was holding and sits down.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: This is a bit heavy, so I'll put it down a bit. Adventurer, would you like to sit here too?
