lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Did you say feta? But what's going on?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: (Growling.)
(Instead of Peta's answer, a growling sound is heard. It sounds like it is coming from Peta's stomach.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Because I'm still not a good wizard. You have to eat a lot to replenish your magical power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What do you mean...?)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Then let me tell you.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I am the Sylvaria Empire Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Magic Office?)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You are surprised as soon as you hear your affiliation. As expected, the image of the Ministry of Magic is a mess.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You have to listen to what people say until the end.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I am an apprentice wizard working in a private capacity. Although I am not a member of a specific faction, I joined the Etoile Allied Forces because I wanted to try something different.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: There are a lot of magicians in places like Luman, but in other places there are not enough so they were specially dispatched by the Allied Forces.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That's why I came to Gerda.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The only thing I'm doing right now is replenishing my magical energy by eating.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: If you need magical power during Io's research, we can use elemental magic instead, or we can make simple magic tools and provide them to the villagers.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: In Luman, a Jewel School wizard infused magic into a jewel that had lost its luster.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … So what do you want to say to me? Seeing as the story is getting longer, it seems like the real story is different.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I spoke a long time. Adventurer is correct. It's not another story... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's a story about a certain witch. The witch came to me and asked if I would become her servant. That too, inside the Sylvaria Magic Agency building.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch? And the Ministry of Magic?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It's something to be surprised at. I was surprised too. Why at the Magic Agency... ? I am a person who has nothing to do with witches... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Since I refused to serve him, the witch told me to tell her when I meet someone named %s.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: They said if I didn't, they would find me and kill me, so I kept it until now.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Because my life is precious. Now, take it.
(Peta passes a piece of paper that looks like a bookmark between the gaps in the magic book.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I don't know. He said that when the time comes, he will go to someone with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that witch look like?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I thought I had definitely seen it, but I think I erased my memory of that part. I can't remember anything except that I saw a man named Zephyrus there.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I definitely told you this. Phew, it seems like the frustration is going away... . Ah, I think there was some sort of curse placed on me.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That witch really tried to kill me... . I ate it all this time to avoid dying... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I'm hungry then so... . Cursed or not, I'm still a human being, so I'm hungry. See you later, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is what that wizard said true?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch who erases memories?  Why did you give this to me... . And this is… ?
(The following text is written in careful cursive on the paper that Adventurer is holding.)
“A night that someone has been waiting for for a long time. Regardless of that night, the night others have been waiting for will come. “If it’s for your God, be together until the end.”
